200.description:
One of the site's standing tender lists as one page: open (Advertised Requests, currently open for responses), new_this_week, closed (closed and under evaluation), awarded (Results: awarded, no offers received, all offers declined), early_advice (Early Tender Advice, future requests with an estimated advertising date) or open_dcsp (open requests under the Delivering Community Services in Partnership policy). Every row carries the tender_id for get_tender, the request number, state, type, issuing agency, UNSPSC categories, the date column (closing / closed / estimated advertising date) as printed and normalised to Perth time, and whether a briefing or site visit is mandatory. The site renders the whole list in one page; there is no server-side pagination.

The response contains the tool result directly.

post.description: To find tenders by keyword (e.g. cleaning), agency, region, state or date range. Ids for public_authority_id, issuing_business_id, region_id and pre_qualification_level_id come from lookups.

aboriginal_participation.description:
Aboriginal Procurement Policy participation filter (form field app).

Provider reference: allowed values ["any", "applicable", "not_applicable"]; default "any".

dcsp.description:
Delivering Community Services in Partnership policy filter.

Provider reference: allowed values ["any", "applicable", "not_applicable"]; default "any".

issuing_business_id.description: Issuing agency id from lookups(issuing_agencies); -1 or omitted = any.

keywords.description: Keyword(s), max 50 characters as the form allows. Matched over request number, title and description.

match.description:
exact: the keywords as one phrase (form value exactMatch); any: any of the words (anyWord).

Provider reference: allowed values ["exact", "any"]; default "exact".

pre_qualification_level_id.description: Builder pre-qualification level id from lookups(pre_qualification_levels); -1 or omitted = any.

public_authority_id.description: Public authority id from lookups(public_authorities); -1 or omitted = any.

region_id.description: Region id from lookups(regions), e.g. 7 = Perth Metropolitan; -1 or omitted = any.

state.description:
Request state, using the form's own values (Open = Current, Early Advice = Future, NoOffsReceived = No Offers Received, AllOffsDeclined = All Offers Declined).

Provider reference: allowed values ["Open", "Early Advice", "Closed", "Awarded", "Withdrawn", "Shortlisted", "Expired", "NoOffsReceived", "AllOffsDeclined"]; default "Open".

type.description:
Request type, form values.

Provider reference: allowed values ["Any", "requestForTender", "expressionOfInterest", "earlytenderadvice", "draftforcomment", "unadvertisedClosedTender", "onlineQuote"]; default "Any".

unspsc_codes.description: Up to three UNSPSC codes (form fields unspscCode1..3).

work_type.description:
goods = Goods & Services, works = Works.

Provider reference: allowed values ["any", "goods", "works"]; default "any".

200.description:
Advanced tender search (the site's do-advanced-tender-search form): keyword (exact phrase or any word) over title, number and description, request state (Open, Closed, Awarded, Early Advice, Withdrawn, Shortlisted, Expired, No Offers Received, All Offers Declined), request type, goods/works, request number, title, public authority and issuing agency ids, region id, up to three UNSPSC codes, opening / closing / awarded date ranges (dd/MM/yyyy), Aboriginal participation, DCSP and pre-qualification level. Rows have the same shape as list_tenders. The server returns everything matching in one page and prints a notice when it cut the list; that notice is returned as `truncated` (narrow the filters), there is no next page. An empty result is the site's own 'No results found.' notice.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | number |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `query` | object | The filters as sent to the form (form field names and values), for the record. |
| `tenders` | object[] |  |
| `truncated` | boolean | True when the site printed that the results were reduced because too many records matched. |
| `url` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
